analysis.title: Start Analysis
analysis.subtitle: Upload source code or provide a server path to begin analysis
analysis.clickToUpload: Click to upload or drag and drop
analysis.enableAiAnalysisTooltip: Enable detailed AI-powered code analysis and enrichment. Requires valid API Configuration.
analysis.useStreamingParseTooltip: Parse files in a streaming manner to save memory for large projects.
analysis.skipDtoSourceTooltip: Exclude DTO class source code from analysis to reduce noise.
analysis.skipDtoMethodsTooltip: Exclude methods within DTO classes from analysis.
analysis.workersTooltip: Number of parallel worker threads for parsing.
analysis.timeoutTooltip: Parse timeout per file in seconds.
analysis.complexityLimitTooltip: Skip files exceeding this complexity score.
analysis.includePackagesTooltip: Comma-separated list of packages to include in sequence diagrams (prefix match).
analysis.concurrentRequestsTooltip: Max number of concurrent AI API requests.
analysis.enrichmentBatchSizeTooltip: Number of items per batch for AI enrichment (server-side buffering).
analysis.proTipContent: For large projects, using the Server Path option is faster as it avoids uploading large files through the browser.
